req.title: Health probe returns liveness
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /health/ with HTTP 200 and a status:'ok' JSON body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing status:'ok'. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) positive EP test asserts exact status code 200 and exact JSON body {'status':'ok'} — catches status-code mutations and body-content mutations; (2) negative NEG test verifies that an unsupported method (POST) on /health/ returns 405, not 200 — catches mutations that widen the allowed-method set or return 200 unconditionally; (3) boundary BVA test asserts the Content-Type header is application/json and that the 'status' key value is exactly the string 'ok' (not 'OK', not True, not 1) — catches constant-string mutations; (4) DT test verifies the response body has exactly one key ('status') with no extra fields — catches mutations that add/remove fields; (5) STC test verifies idempotency by issuing two sequential GET requests and asserting both return identical status codes and bodies — catches stateful mutations that alter behaviour on repeated calls.

tests.name: test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
health_route is registered on the app
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body == {"status": "ok"}

test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok()

health_route is registered on the app
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Inspect Content-Type header and exact string value of 'status' key
expected: JSON key 'status' has value exactly 'ok' (lowercase, string type)
Value is not 'OK', not True, not 1, not None
trace: R-PLAYER-016: status:'ok' JSON body — exact string constant
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_response_content_type_is_json_and_status_value_exact():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    body = response.json()
    status_value = body["status"]
    assert status_value == "ok"
    assert status_value != "OK"
    assert status_value != "Ok"
    assert status_value is not True
    assert status_value != 1

test_health_response_content_type_is_json_and_status_value_exact()

No extra keys are present in the response body

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_response_body_has_exactly_one_key():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) == 1
    assert "status" in body
    assert body["status"] == "ok"

test_health_response_body_has_exactly_one_key()

tests.name: test_health_idempotent_on_repeated_calls
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
health_route is registered on the app
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Compare status codes and bodies of both responses
expected: Both responses return identical JSON body {"status": "ok"}
trace: R-PLAYER-016: liveness probe must be deterministic across calls
STC: catches stateful mutations that alter behaviour on repeated invocations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_idempotent_on_repeated_calls():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get("/health/")
    r2 = client.get("/health/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code
    body1 = r1.json()
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body1 == {"status": "ok"}
    assert body2 == {"status": "ok"}
    assert body1 == body2

test_health_idempotent_on_repeated_calls()
